ns2:course.label: Seminar History of Philosophy
ns2:course.description: Study of selected major philosophers, movements, problems, or topics in the history of philosophy; see Class Schedule for current topics. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated. Students may register in more than one section per term. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor for non-philosophy graduate students.
